## Legend

BA = `business-analyst` · DEV = `developer` · REV = `reviewer` · SEC = `security-analyst` · TST = `tester` · QA = `qa-engineer` · DBG = `debugger` · DOC = `document-writer` · OPS = `devops` · CI = `cicd`
